description: 再生能源裝(設)置容量月資料 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部能源署. 1. 資料內涵：我國當月再生能源裝(設)置容量統計表。 2. 收集目的：做為我國再生能源相關政策規劃與管理之依據。 3. 收集方式：由各能源供給端之再生能源裝置容量申報數據彙整而得。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部能源署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
